sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
Prof. C.E. Kolambe Secretary, Alumni Association of APCOER 9552201336 Chetan.kolambe@abmspcoerpune.org linkedin.com/in/chetan-kolambe-92314617
As Secretary of the Alumni Association of APCOER, I consider it an honor to welcome you all to this alumni portal. It is indeed my earnest desire to bring the alumni closer through this medium, and I truly believe this platform will reconnect all of us. I am on the mission of connecting existing alumni with the institute & bridge the gap of communication between alumni and existing students. Our Association will provide a very good forum to keep connected with each other across the globe. The Alumni Association helps in sharing the practical aspects of old studentsâ€™ knowledge and development of the College. I would be looking forward to your suggestions to make our community vibrant, informative and highly interactive. Any suggestions for better functioning of the Alumni Association are heartily welcomed.
